preconditions.description: The grid dimensions n and m are within the specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: len(grid) == n and all(len(row) == m for row in grid)
preconditions.description: The grid has n rows, each of length m.

preconditions.expression: all(cell in {'W', 'B'} for row in grid for cell in row)
preconditions.description: Each cell in the grid is either 'W' (white) or 'B' (black).

postconditions.description: The output is a non-negative integer representing the minimum number of coins spent.

postconditions.expression: all(grid[i][j] == target_grid[i][j] for i in range(n) for j in range(m))
postconditions.description: The final grid matches the target grid after performing the operations.
